turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on a, an and the?
turns.tutor:
Hi! Let me do one for you first.
I eat an egg. I listen to the first sound of "egg": "e". It is a vowel sound. So I use "an".
Rule: say "an" before a vowel sound, "a" before other sounds.
Right: I have a cat. Wrong: I have an cat.
Now you. Write a or an:
She has ___ orange in her bag. (answer with only the missing word)
